title: Session: 2.25.0 update posts
objective: 2.25.0 posts what's new for members in a channel officers choose with /config changelog, when the bot starts on a newer version. Setting a channel posts nothing at once, and an update with nothing for members posts nothing. Migration 009 and one new command path.
user: /config changelog channel:#<plain members channel> (not officer-chat, the lobby or community-updates): a success receipt, and /config validate shows an OK Changelog line.

/config changelog channel:#officer-chat: the warning receipt, and a [WARN] Changelog line in /config validate. The same command again: the no-change card, still with a Visibility warning. Then set it back to the plain channel.
After the assistant's first restart: exactly one post in that channel, 'TaruBot updated to v2.25.0' with one field. After the second restart: no new post.
assistant: With the owner's go-ahead: stop, back up, restore-check at 008, rehearse migration 009 on the copy, migrate tarubot_dev, then up (ENABLE_EFFECTS=true).
Register the guild commands; commands.js list is clean with /config changelog (20 roots, 45 paths).
With the owner's OK, set changelog_version to the release just below 2.25.0 and restart; once the job succeeded and the version advanced, restart again.
Record the rollout in docs/DEV_GUILD.md and docs/VERIFICATION.md.
bot: Queue one update post for each server behind the running version, and post it in its changelog channel.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in #chat.
